'''Jento Svarthos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|general]] during the time period known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Jento was present in the [[Vaiken Spacedock]], headquarters of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Fleet]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jento Svarthos was added in the [[2017]] Update 5.6 following the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion. He has no interaction options and no dialogue. The character shares a name and exact appearance with the signal in-game character of Jason Kidwell, who died with cancer in [[2015]].<ref name="Memoral">{{WebCite|url=https://csillanrose.enjin.com/forum/m/25356776/viewthread/24367812-ooc-memorial-for-jento-svarthos-jason-kidman|text=Ooc Memorial for Jento Svarthos / Jason Kidman |archivedate=20230429084530}}</ref>
